title: sar-cose: minimal reference implementation of the Sovereign Acceptance Runtime (SAR)
description:
Reference implementation of the authorization path of the Sovereign Acceptance Runtime (SAR) described in the working paper Sovereign Acceptance Runtime: Verifiable Human Ratification and Evidentiary Audit Trails for Autonomous AI Agents under the EU AI Act (v1.2).

Proposal and Ratification Statements are COSE_Sign1 objects (RFC 9052) over deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1), signed with Ed25519 (algorithm -19, RFC 9864). A fail-closed Execution Gate implements normative decision rules S1-S13 (SEMANTICS.md), including separation of roles and gate-audit consistency; a hash-chained SQLite store with signed checkpoints records every decision.

Includes a second implementation written blind from the paper, a 115-test suite (differential, property-based, cross-implementation and concurrency tests), 26 hand-written mutants and an automated mutation sweep (431/444 killed; survivors argued equivalent). Research prototype; SCITT Transparency Service integration (Receipts) is not implemented.
